Knowing him more than 5 years . I wasn’t able to walk due to herniated disc. He saved me from getting surgery. His approach of the treatment is not like others. Many pt’s was doing traction- electroshock etc. To fix your pain temporary but he is simply looking for the root of the problem and fixes it. Follows up with clients. He is awesome.

Recently from straining in toilet and deadlifting heavy I got the pelvic organ prolapse. Doctor told me directly to have surgery and pay astromic amount of money. I have visited him and he found out my pelvic floor is chronically tight. So he did pelvic floor therapy to me and since then I dont have much pain and dont have much prolapse like before.
Also found out pelvic floor tightness brings other problems with like lower back pain, hip pain and others. If you are suffering from chronic pain or pelvic pain , just visit him once and he might change your life. Highly recommended

Awesome PT for cpps. I was experiencing extremely painful pelvic pain. The therapist gave me exercises and a strict diet to follow. Im from America and have dealt with lots of PT and this was much better. The physical therapist still contact me now to ask how i am doing and to remind me to keeping doing my stretches. Highly recommend

Kridchai’s modern approach to solving pelvic pain not only gave new meaning to a pain free life again but gives hope for many to come.
Combining cutting-edge problem solving with a humanistic element was key to successfully reducing pain and restoring confidence that there are still practitioners that care.
Kridchai is a pain reducing soldier continuously searching for answers when faced with more complicated issues and keeps in constant contact long after the session is complete.
Dedication is an understatement.
One of the top reasons I wouldn’t move from Phuket.
The pain and numbness that I had suffered from for years have improved almost completely after just one treatment. 🙏👍👍👍 …

The physical therapist was very skilled. She provided excellent treatment and also gave me advice on self-care. My pain is gone now. The service was good, they were cheerful, and the price was reasonable. 😊 …

The doctor is highly skilled and has a great personality. I guarantee all symptoms will be cured; I've experienced it myself. The treatment techniques are unlike anywhere else. I guarantee a 1000% cure.

The detailed consultation helped me understand the cause of my symptoms, significantly reducing my anxiety. Importantly, they used a unique treatment technique with almost no equipment, purely skill. I improved dramatically from the very first session. I was very impressed!

This technique is amazing because it's curable on the first try!
I really like this technique. It doesn't just use medical equipment for treatment, but also includes a well-designed, appropriate exercise program.
